text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd said on Tuesday its Wharf (Holdings) Ltd cable television unit Wharf Cable Ltd had more than 310,000 subscribers by the end of 1996.
"By the end of the year...Cable Television turned a corner. It had achieved a subscriber level by the end of the year of over 310,000," Wheelock managing director John Hung said in an interview.
"So our expectation for operating at breakeven by the end of 1997 is very much on track," he added.
In December, the Hong Kong Economic Journal newspaper quoted Wharf Cable chairman Stephen Ng as saying the company would post an estimated operating loss of HK$400 million in calendar 1996.
Wharf Cable posted a loss of HK$824 million in 1995, the newspaper said.
